selection: All five pydicom/pydicom development instances, selected for one locally runnable pure-Python environment before agent outcomes. This is a convenience pilot, not a representative SWE-bench sample.
intervention: Replace only the native explore subagent model response with Jev ranking deterministic file candidates. Writer, tools, issue, and budget stay fixed.
confidence_policy: Select three highest finite Noul relevance scores. This is a ranking experiment; no calibrated acceptance claim. On decision API or validation error, use the native explorer and charge both costs.
evaluation: Apply official test_patch only in evaluator copy, run published FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS nodes under local pytest. Validate broken-base fails and gold patch passes. Not official Docker SWE-bench.
future_direction: Original BANKING77/CLINC150 intent decisions with tool-using escalation, deferred until the coding-harness experiment is established.
environment_notes: pytest 7 retains historical nose-style setup; setuptools supplies pkg_resources. Truncated upstream parameter IDs expand to the whole parent test function, adding regression cases rather than dropping them.
